samples.claim: If segment has more remaining values than requested, slice requested ordinal range, extend output and keep current segment with increased offset. Adjacent plain output ranges may merge through extend.

samples.claim: Nested StatisticsMetadata stores repeated Field schema=1, repeated int32 leaf-field IDs fields=2, and uint64 page_table_position=3. Statistics schema can be empty or cover only some fields. Each fields entry identifies a stats-schema field and corresponds to one statistics page-table column; the table is N by 2 because there is always one batch. Metadata.statistics uses tag 5, deliberately not the reserved historical tag 4. Historical reservation rationale is at protos/file.proto:25-29.

samples.claim: Section separator and public Debug/Clone/Copy/PartialEq/Eq CacheMissReason enumerate InvalidEnvelope (bad/unknown/truncated/non-UTF8 framing), TypeMismatch, VersionTooNew and BodyError. Docs assign all reasons recomputation by the backend and allow distinct metrics; this enum itself neither evicts nor invokes a loader.

144 | /// Why a cache entry could not be decoded into the expected type.
145 | ///
